name: done-gate
description: Blocks Claude from ending a turn while code under guarded paths differs from the working tree that last passed the repository's check command. Proof is a git tree id of the whole working tree, so edits through Edit, Write, Bash or a subagent all count. Blocks once, then lets the turn end with a toast. Inactive without .claude/done-gate.json. Needs function hooks (early access).
